title: Rationale-Aware Answer Verification by Pairwise Self-Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the average length of selected rationales as the number of candidate solutions and pairwise comparison rounds increase, demonstrating that iterative LLM-based evaluation amplifies the inherent preference for longer text.
Mitigating the evaluator model's preference for a specific position by alternating the presentation order of the candidate rationales during head-to-head pairwise comparisons.
